programs.title: Photographer
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the work of respected photographers.Paul Nicklen and Cristina Mittermeier, Anand Varma, Dan Winters, Campbell Addy, Krystle Wright and Muhammed Muheisen talk about their professional experiences.Each episode presents the life of one of the enthusiasts - from childhood and the beginning of his career to modern times and current challenges.Exciting stories are enriched by archival recordings, interviews and fragments of current projects.Viewers will learn the stories behind famous photos and the motivations of the people who decided to stand behind the camera.

programs.title: Europe From Above 4
programs.desc: The creators of the series will present Scotland, Denmark, Serbia, Belgium, Bulgaria and Romania from a bird's eye view.They will use, among others, modern drones.Viewers will see the greatest cultural and geographical national treasures.They will see how tradition, engineering and nature have shaped these places.In the first episode they will go to Scotland.They will soar over the town of St Andrews and see how gardeners look after the famous golf course.In East Lothian they will see natural treasures, including honey bees feasting on heather flowers.They will then investigate an ambitious engineering project that harnesses the power of the ocean to generate electricity.A team of archaeologists will reconstruct a traditional Scottish house.

programs.title: Trafficked with Mariana Van Zeller
programs.desc: Correspondent Mariana van Zeller has been following the trail of smugglers for over fifteen years.During his dangerous work, he meets not only criminals, but also representatives of the justice system, former prisoners and members of local communities.The journalist paints a shocking picture of the gray zone where billions of dollars are traded.The reporter will learn about the activities of counterfeiters, drug dealers, and the illegal sale of weapons, fentanyl and animals.Her interlocutors included Joe Exotic, the former owner of the controversial zoo.In 2019, he was sentenced to 22 years in prison.
